scenes.name: THE INVERSE QUESTION
lines: If adding two independent copies creates little extra uncertainty, must the original distribution be close to a structured one?
把两个独立副本相加后，如果不确定性增加得少，原分布就一定接近某种结构分布吗？
Tao studied this inverse question for classical entropy. Bu, Gu and Jaffe proposed a quantitative estimate for mixed quantum states.
Tao 研究了经典熵的这个逆问题。Bu、Gu 和 Jaffe 对混合量子态提出了一个定量估计。
Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang explain a counterexample made from two equally likely outcomes among seven positions.
Haobo Ma 和 Wenlin Zhang 解释了一个反例：在七个位置中，只让两个结果等概率出现。

scenes.name: FOUR INPUT PAIRS
lines: Label a fair coin zero or one. Choose two independent outcomes, I and J, and retain twice I plus twice J, modulo seven.
把公平硬币的结果记为零和一，独立选择 I 和 J，保留模七的二倍 I 加二倍 J。
The four equally likely input pairs give zero, two, two, and four. The two middle events merge.
四种等可能的输入对给出零、二、二、四。中间两个事件合并。
So the output probabilities are one quarter, one half, and one quarter. The coefficients are admissible because four plus four equals one modulo seven.
所以输出概率是四分之一、二分之一、四分之一。系数合法，因为四加四在模七意义下等于一。

scenes.name: HOW MUCH GROWTH?
lines: Entropy is average information: sum each probability times minus its natural logarithm. A fair coin has entropy log two.
熵是平均信息量：把每个概率乘以其自然对数的负值再求和。公平硬币的熵是 log 2。
For our output, each of the three nonzero terms contributes half of log two. The total is three halves of log two.
对这个输出，三个非零项各贡献半个 log 2，总和为三倍的半个 log 2。
The increase is half of log two. Exponentiating gives the quantum doubling constant, the square root of two.
熵增加了半个 log 2。取指数后，量子倍增常数就是根号二。

scenes.name: THE COMPARISON STATE
lines: This diagonal quantum state is an ordinary probability distribution, with no coherence. Its mean state keeps only perfectly determined Fourier-like coefficients.
这个对角量子态就是普通概率分布，没有相干项。它的均值态只保留完全确定的 Fourier 型系数。
On the clock axis, each coefficient averages two unit arrows. Away from the origin their directions differ, so the average has length less than one.
在钟方向上，每个系数是两个单位箭头的平均。离开原点后，箭头方向不同，平均长度就小于一。
Shift coefficients vanish. Only the origin survives, making the mean uniform on all seven positions. The relative entropy from that mean is log seven over two.
移动方向的系数为零。只剩原点系数，所以均值态在七个位置上均匀分布。相对于均值态的相对熵是 log(7/2)。

scenes.name: THE EXACT CONTRADICTION
lines: The proposed bound uses the mean rank, purity, and a coefficient factor between zero and one. Here the rank is seven and purity is one half.
预期上界使用均值态的秩、纯度和一个介于零与一之间的系数因子。本例秩为七，纯度为二分之一。
Even allowing every factor in that interval, the denominator is at least log two. At the actual doubling constant, the proposed bound is at most half of log seven.
即使允许因子取遍整个区间，分母也至少为 log 2。在实际倍增常数处，预期上界至多为半个 log 7。
But log seven over two is strictly larger than half of log seven, because seven is greater than four. This is an exact contradiction, with a positive denominator.
但 log(7/2) 严格大于半个 log 7，因为七大于四。这是分母为正时的精确矛盾。

scenes.name: EVERY POSITIVE NUMBER OF COPIES
lines: Now take n independent copies, for any positive integer n. Input entropy and relative entropy add, while the mean spreads over seven to the n labels.
现在取 n 个独立副本，其中 n 是任意正整数。输入熵和相对熵相加，均值态铺在七的 n 次方个标签上。
The discrepancy is n times log seven over two. The proposed bound is still at most n times half of log seven. Every positive number of copies fails.
差异是 n 倍 log(7/2)，预期上界仍至多是 n 倍的半个 log 7。每个正整数份副本都使它失败。

scenes.name: WHY THE WEAKER BOUND SURVIVES
lines: The source also gives a weaker estimate, equation fifty nine. For this family its denominator is positive and smaller than half of log two.
原文还给出了较弱的式五十九。对本族，它的分母为正，且小于半个 log 2。
The allowed log C is at least n times half of log two. Dividing by the smaller positive denominator makes that weaker bound strictly larger than the actual discrepancy.
允许的 log C 至少为 n 倍的半个 log 2。除以更小的正分母后，这个较弱上界严格大于实际差异。
This proves the weaker estimate strictly for these product states, including at the smallest allowed C. It does not prove it for every mixed state.
这证明了较弱估计对这些乘积态严格成立，包括最小允许 C 的情形；没有证明任意混合态的情形。

scenes.name: WHAT IS ESTABLISHED
lines: The public Lean theorem proves the universal single-system estimate false. Its proof uses this same seven-level witness.
公开 Lean 定理证明单系统的普遍估计为假，证明使用同一个七维见证。
The explicit all-factor statement, every tensor power, and the weaker estimate have complete written arguments in the note and focused formalization requests.
明确的全因子陈述、每个张量幂和较弱估计在原稿中都有完整书面论证，并有范围明确的形式化请求。
The pure-state theorem remains intact. The obstruction is already classical. The note credits the single-system construction to trureturing contributors.
纯态定理不受影响。障碍已经存在于经典概率中。原稿将单系统构造归功于 trureturing contributors。
